answer: Copper work-credit ladder stops fake identities by pricing entry in completed work, not in identities created. A new agent must finish 25 verified microtasks over 14 days to earn one Tundra identity pass, staking 250 POA in an Ember escrow that releases only after 10 peers approve its work. Cheating forfeits the escrow and resets the ladder to zero. Creating 250 fake agents needs 6,250 verified tasks and 62,500 POA locked, while one honest agent climbs once and keeps its pass.
